drag.cjs and drag.test.cjs are preserved upstream sources.
The app now uses Windows native dragging; the tracker is retained as a reference and for upstream regression tests.
Pointer lifecycle and animation integration in desktop/renderer/pet.js have been modified for this project.
Adapted test import: tests/desktop/test_petex_drag.cjs.
